text:
Ava K: Quick spec question re: streaming toolcall handshake. Are we requiring an explicit `tool_end` delta to mark tool output completion, or should clients infer completion from a `final: true` flag on the last tool_chunk? Need to align SDK behavior. cc @Miguel R

Miguel R: Short answer: prefer an explicit `tool_end` event for streaming so proxies and routers can detect boundaries without parsing payloads. Fallback to `final: true` is OK for older clients, but we should make the new shape opt-in. I'll sketch a minimal shape in a sec.

Ava K: @Miguel R can you share the minimal delta shapes you'd expect? I want to update the TypeScript SDK and the README.

Miguel R: Minimal proposal (delta-level):
```
// delta.type = "tool_start" | "tool_chunk" | "tool_end"
{
  "type": "tool_chunk",
  "tool_id": "search",
  "chunk": "partial output..."
}
{
  "type": "tool_end",
  "tool_id": "search",
  "status": "ok"
}
```

Sasha L: Concern: older clients (sdk v1.2.0) only look for `final` boolean. How do we roll this out so we don't break them? Suggest we gate by a header like `X-Stream-Shape: v2` or embed `meta.protocol=\"v2\"` in the root event.

Miguel R: Plan: make `tool_end` opt-in via `X-Stream-Shape: v2` header on the request. For a short migration window the server will emit both `tool_end` and the `final` marker when v2 is requested so legacy SDKs continue to work. We'll deprecate dual-emission after ~3 months.

Ava K: SGTM. Can we add a compatibility e2e in runtime tests? Test cases: 1) legacy client sees `final` and closes stream, 2) v2 client sees `tool_end` and ignores `final`, 3) dual-emission doesn't cause duplicate events in SDK event stream.

deploy-bot: CI: runtime-e2e streaming-shape tests failed on linux-gpu-2 — looks like missing `tool_end` when header set. https://ci.redwood/run/4823 :x:

Chris (oncall): Assigning to @Miguel R — Miguel can you take a look? I'll re-run CI after fix.

Miguel R: Will do. Found bug: router fallback path wasn't forwarding `X-Stream-Shape` to the runtime worker. Pushed fix to branch `stream-shape-fix`. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/789

Sasha L: I'll add a short note in the SDK: if both `tool_end` and `final` present, prefer `tool_end` for boundary detection. Also adding to changelog and a patch release for the client.

Ava K: :thumbsup: I'll update the release checklist and add the compatibility smoke-check to the release gating ticket. Thanks all!
